items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I first went out with Ambrose then... Oh, that's my first start with them men. Yeah, he's one of the men that carried me out.

ctx.x: I'm plenty cool. Uh, now I was wondering about this guy, uh, Tato, you know, I'm not going to play, and, uh, I'd say, would you say that he played anything like Willie Cornish and Frankie Deucon? Yeah.
When they played valve? That's right. Of the same order. Jupiter, T, and that bunch, that's all was valve players too. Ambrose. Those men played valve.
